topic: Brief description on application of Radar in surveillance operation.
syllabus_extract: Brief description on application of Radar in surveillance operation. Features generally available on surveillance radar. Information obtained by surveillance radar. Concept of controlling and supporting aircraft taking part in surveillance operation and methods of passing information.
specific_objectives: 18.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to appraise the function of secondary radars in ASW operation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of surveillance radar features and information flow diagrams using PPT slides.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a surveillance radar?
Name two types of radar used in ASW operations.
How does a secondary radar differ from a primary radar?

summary_questions: Explain the role of secondary radar in Anti-Submarine Warfare operations.
Describe the standard methods used for passing surveillance information between aircraft.
